sentences.en: I rub the soles of my feet with pumice in order to smooth them.
sentences.zh: 为了使脚底光滑，我用浮石磨脚底。

sentences.en: The volcano erupted and left behind large chunks of pumice.
sentences.zh: 火山爆发后留下了许多浮石的大块。

sentences.en: She used a pumice stone to scrub off the rough patches on her skin.
sentences.zh: 她用一块浮石磨掉了皮肤上的粗糙部分。
